## Parent

https://github.com/TabTty/TabTty/issues/4

## What to build

Create folders and rename entries from the transfer window using the same operation admission, state, and outcome rules as transfers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Route both local and remote create/rename commands through named file operations while preserving existing path, raw-name, identity, and no-follow behavior.
- [ ] Capture the request and connection identity; cancellation, disconnect, or stale completion cannot retarget another operation. Shared presentation renders read-only state instead of releasing an operation manually.
- [ ] Keep these operations outside the four-transfer-batch restriction while enforcing actual provider limits and required mutation serialization.
- [ ] Only an accepted operation replaces the latest result and transfer-retry metadata together. Rejected starts preserve both; create/rename do not inherit a previous transfer's retry list.
- [ ] Report uncertain sent mutations accurately and require the existing refresh/rechecks before further mutation. Do not add automatic create/rename replay.
- [ ] Verify the complete window-to-operation path with controlled admission/target-change/reply-loss cases plus real local and SFTP operations.

comments.body:
Named create and rename operations now share admission, result replacement, and unknown-outcome handling. Release validation passed for Windows folder create and rename and loopback SSH/SFTP folder create and file rename using the production operations. Changes are in the TabTty working tree.

Overall plan [#4](https://github.com/TabTty/TabTty/issues/4).
